name: web-ai-search-analytics-landing-and-pricing-two-page-preview
title: White AI-visibility SaaS pages: centred headline, framed dashboard preview, logo row, feature cards and pricing
whatItIs: Two white desktop pages: one with a tiny nav and banner, a centred 'See where your brand's position in AI search.' with black and outlined buttons, a framed dashboard with charts, leaderboards and source tables and a logo row; and a second with feature cards with mini UI previews and a two-tier pricing block with a Popular badge.
whatItMeans: Clean and credible; a large product preview under a plain headline sells the tool.
techniques: Frame the product dashboard under the hero.
Use tab pills above the preview.
Show features as cards with mini UI.

vocabulary.definition: A screenshot placed in a bordered frame.
Pills labelled Overview, Analytics, Actions above a preview.
A card with a mini UI example.
A tag on the recommended plan.
